crossRefs.note: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there…
Wolves will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will…
But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of…
Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein; and it…
As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither…
The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by…
Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all the animals of the nations. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge…
Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of…
He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons…
A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will…
therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on…
I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man…
“Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says Yahweh, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand…
They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.

translations.web: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: “I will make her a place for owls and for swamplands; I will sweep her away with the broom of destruction,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.
